title: I Am Not the Christ
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: John the Baptist taught by the Jordan River. He told people to repent. To repent is to stop doing wrong and come back to Heavenly Father.
Leaders in Jerusalem sent priests to ask him, “Who are you?” John told the truth. “I am not the Christ,” he said. He was not the promised Savior.
Isaiah had said a voice would call out in the wild, empty land. John said, “I am that voice.”
p2: “Make the way ready for the Lord,” John said. “I baptize with water. But Someone much greater is coming.”
John said he was not good enough even to untie His shoes. He wanted people to look for Jesus. Tonight, be honest like John, and tell someone about Jesus.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
